# Nico Verde

> Creative Manager. 10 years in content, 15M+ views. I make campaigns that sell, for companies moving fast enough to keep up. Based in Atlanta, GA.

Nico Verde (Nicholas Crowell) is a Creative Manager working across video production, photography, marketing strategy, and content clipping. This site is his portfolio: recent campaigns, case studies, a photo/art gallery, essays, and booking info.

Note for automated agents: this site's page content is rendered client-side by a small JavaScript templating runtime. A JS-executing crawler will see the full content described below; a plain HTTP fetch will only see each page's <title>, meta description, and JSON-LD.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://nicoverde.house/): Hero intro, recent campaigns (Verde House, LinkedOut, Underground Journal), content categories, skills, and about section.
- [Book Me](https://nicoverde.house/Book-Me.html): Rates and services for video production, photography, clipping, and consulting.
- [Gallery](https://nicoverde.house/Gallery.html): Photography and visual art gallery.
- [Writing](https://nicoverde.house/Writing.html): Index of essays and guides.
- [Verde House](https://nicoverde.house/Verde-House.html): Case study on building the Verde House event brand and selling out a 350+ person launch party.
- [LinkedOut](https://nicoverde.house/LinkedOut.html): Case study on an AI-powered LinkedIn parody app built and pitched in 12 hours, 1st place at HackLanta 2026.
- [Underground Journal](https://nicoverde.house/Underground-Journal.html): Case study on building a marketing team from scratch and growing submissions 507% for Georgia State's Underground Journal.
- [Campaigns, Coming Soon](https://nicoverde.house/Campaigns-Coming-Soon.html): Work in progress and past campaigns not yet added to the main portfolio.
